cases.prompt: Plant A and Plant B have about the same number of machines connected and the same MES, but Plant B shows hardly any savings. Why, and what should we do about it? (fictional plants)
cases.expected_output: Builds a comparison set and checks effort parity first. Places each gap on one of the four Ishikawa branches with evidence and a confidence label. Checks the technology branch last. Ends with roadmap rows that have owner role, date, status and call for action. Does not decide anything for the OD lead.

cases.prompt: A new plant just entered OD scope and has no dedicated key user yet but a high estimated value. Should it be first mover or fast follower? (fictional)
cases.expected_output: Answers each tier criterion with its source or marks it unknown. Proposes fast follower for now because no staffed key user, labelled as a proposal. States the tier decides central capacity, not eligibility. Names the roadmap rows that would promote the plant. Leaves the decision to the OD lead.

cases.prompt: The use case shows zero saving in three plants, so let's write 'no potential' in the list and close it.
cases.expected_output: Refuses to write no potential. Runs the scaling test with three lists (saved, deployed without saving, still has potential). Marks deployments without saving as to be evaluated. Says only the OD lead with the plant owner may decide no potential.

cases.prompt: A plant has no machines recorded yet. Where does it start in the OD process and in what order?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as plant onboarding rather than gap diagnosis. Points to the onboarding path skill instead of producing an Ishikawa diagnosis or tier.

should_trigger: Why does one of our plants save much less than another similar plant?
Write the call-for-action text and status per plant for the next call
Tier this plant as first mover or fast follower
Turn these workshop interview notes into a plant diagnosis
should_not_trigger: In which order should a new plant go through the OD stages?
Rank these five use cases by value for the region
Is this signal standard usable at the other plants?
Run the monthly risk review against the register
